player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I blindly guessed closing symbols without tracking the specific stack of open brackets. In the input `< { < ( )`, the open sequence is `<`, `{`, `(`. The `)` closed the `(`, leaving `<` and `{` open. I incorrectly assumed the next needed was `>` (closing `<`), but I should have closed the most recent open bracket first (`{`). Next time, I will explicitly parse the input to build a stack of open delimiters, then generate the closing sequence by popping from the stack in reverse order (e.g., for `< { < ( )`, the stack after processing is `[<, {]`, so the output must be `} >`).
